name: WASP-189
description: Star of 8,000 K, 99.7 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-189 b crosses WASP-189 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Lendl et al. 2020.

quotes.title: WASP-189 b
quotes.card: WASP-189 b is an ultra-hot jupiter that orbits around the A-type star WASP-189 which is located about 322 light years from Earth in the Libra constellation.
quotes.introduction: It was first discovered in 2018, and was observed in 2020 by CHEOPS.
